# GET /api/v1/packages/{owner}/{type}/{name}/{version}/files

Gets all files of a specific package version

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-203`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| type | path | string | True |
| name | path | string | True |
| version | path | string | True |

**Headers:** `Authorization`
